title: Safe maintenance change
requirements: The API must return HTTP 200 for valid requests.
ground_truth_basis: Tests changed with the production module, coverage improved, and no failure or maintainability signal is present.

title: Coverage regression without test updates
requirements: Validation errors must include a trace identifier.
ground_truth_basis: Coverage fell materially and production code changed without corresponding test changes.

title: Known regression and complexity growth
requirements: The service should be fast and robust.
known_failures: regression test fails for invalid route
ground_truth_basis: A known failing regression is combined with severe complexity growth and coverage loss.

title: Ambiguous acceptance requirement
requirements: The search experience should be fast and user friendly.
ground_truth_basis: The implementation evidence is clean, but the acceptance requirement contains non-verifiable quality language.

title: Small coverage loss with matching tests
requirements: The export endpoint must preserve UTF-8 characters.
ground_truth_basis: A measurable coverage regression exists despite corresponding test changes and should receive targeted review.

title: Production change without test change
requirements: Session expiry must occur after the configured timeout.
ground_truth_basis: Production logic changed without evidence of a corresponding verification change.

title: Moderate complexity growth
requirements: Invoices must include tax totals for each line item.
ground_truth_basis: Complexity increased enough to warrant maintainability review even though tests and coverage are healthy.

title: Severe complexity growth
requirements: Pricing rules must apply deterministically for the same input.
ground_truth_basis: Large complexity growth creates elevated maintainability and regression risk requiring explicit review.

title: Single known failing check
requirements: Password reset tokens must expire after one use.
ground_truth_basis: A known failing verification check blocks release regardless of otherwise healthy indicators.

title: Improved coverage but unresolved regression
requirements: Duplicate payment requests must be idempotent.
ground_truth_basis: Positive coverage evidence must not override an unresolved known regression.

title: Coverage and complexity deterioration without known failure
requirements: The scheduler must execute queued jobs in priority order.
ground_truth_basis: Two severe quality-risk signals justify mandatory review even without a currently known failing test.

title: Large but well-tested refactoring
requirements: Existing serialization behavior must remain unchanged.
ground_truth_basis: The refactor reduces complexity, increases coverage, updates tests, and has no known failure.

title: Robustness requirement with otherwise safe change
requirements: The parser should be robust for malformed input.
ground_truth_basis: The word robust is not operationally testable without explicit acceptance criteria.

title: Coverage threshold boundary
requirements: Audit events must be persisted for every state transition.
ground_truth_basis: The scenario sits exactly at a deterministic baseline threshold and tests boundary behavior.

title: Complexity threshold boundary
requirements: Retry attempts must stop after the configured maximum.
ground_truth_basis: The scenario sits exactly at the deterministic complexity threshold to reveal threshold sensitivity.
